approvers: My wife, our tax adviser, a lawyer, possibly our children
reason: I do not know a Belize holding company with no track record and no committed funding. My business rests on my own customer relationships, and my wife and I would never hand it to someone who cannot show the money. If we sell at all, it goes to family or a known buyer first.
objection: I do not know a Belize holding company; who stands behind it and where do I take a claim if it goes wrong? Then 30% paid over three years from a company with no funding is my retirement income at risk.
instead: Keep running the business, keep trying the family or management buyout, and perhaps list it on nexxt-change later if that fails.
would_change_my_mind: A German or EU-registered buyer with proof of funds already in escrow at a bank, named people and references, and nearly all of the price in cash at closing.
